verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a web service that also ships SDKs and a Terraform provider, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry, analytics or tracking opt-out. The WHOIS privacy service (namecheap-docs-4) and a user comment that Namecheap doesn't share data without permission are adjacent privacy topics, not tracking controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
